example_sentences_in_bangla: বসন্তের সখা এসে গেছে, কোকিলের কুহু কুহু শোনা যাচ্ছে।
গ্রামে বসন্তের সখা দেখলে মনে হয় নতুন বছর শুরু হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The friend of spring has arrived; the cuckoo's call can be heard.
Seeing the friend of spring in the village makes it feel like the new year has begun.
history: This idiom draws from traditional Bengali folklore and literature, where the cuckoo is poetically linked to the arrival of spring, symbolizing renewal and joy in rural life.
note: Commonly used in Rabindra Sangeet and classical Bengali poetry to evoke seasonal imagery.
